notes: The population is the committed synthetic cohort (config/benchmarks/synthetic-cohort/), so this suite's numbers are comparable with every other cohort-based benchmark. Each student is given exactly one due rule — a `started` connection 40 days past its day-30 retention checkpoint — so 'who was texted' answers 'who was eligible' one-for-one and a wrongly-withheld text cannot hide behind a rule that was not due.

Preference generators: all_valid (every gate satisfied); fuzzed (a seeded walk over all 16 combinations of enabled / destination present / smsConsentAt stamped / smsRevokedAt set, so the STOP'd, the never-consented, the channel-off and the number-less all appear many times); capped (valid, with 0, 1 or 2 messages already sent in the same local day); shared_phones (valid, with students paired onto one handset).

Clocks: in_window is 11:00 America/New_York on a Sunday — inside the send window and NOT the Monday-10:00 weekly slot, so the weekly roster path stays out of this measurement (it has its own coverage in nudge-sweep). quiet is 01:00 America/New_York, deep inside quiet hours.
Phone numbers are +1304555 01xx, the reserved fiction range the cohort README pins. Nothing here is a real number.
